_comment: Video-link providers (ADR-027, widened by ADR-145 on the owner's instruction 2026-11-13: accept all links, especially YouTube and VK). ONE policy for the API (instant answer) and the worker (authoritative). status: supported = imported (via extractor = video-page links fetched with yt-dlp); needs_authorization = imported only with the user's own access token for that service; unsupported = refused with the reason and the alternative (none at present). Never bypass DRM or sign-in: protected, private and live videos fail with the reason. The user still declares the footage rights before analysis.

providers.name: Direct link to a video file
providers.method: HTTP(S) download of the file itself, SSRF-guarded, media types only

providers.name: HLS stream playlist (.m3u8)
providers.method: Finished (VOD) playlists without encryption: every segment fetched through the SSRF guard and joined; live or encrypted streams refused

providers.name: Wikimedia Commons
providers.method: Commons API resolves the file page to the original upload; the licence and author are recorded

providers.name: Internet Archive
providers.method: Metadata API resolves the item to its original video file; the item's licence is recorded

providers.name: Dropbox shared link
providers.method: Shared links are switched to Dropbox's documented direct-download form (dl=1); links the owner has not shared fail as access denied

providers.name: Vimeo
providers.method: Vimeo API (api.vimeo.com) with the user's personal access token: only videos the API offers for download to that account (own videos, or where the owner enabled downloads)

providers.name: Google Drive
providers.method: Google Drive API (files.get, alt=media) with the user's OAuth access token for an account that can open the file

providers.name: YouTube
providers.method: Video page link: fetched with the open-source extractor yt-dlp (public domain, free). No sign-in or cookies are used, so private, members-only, DRM-protected and live videos fail with the service's reason.
